name: Siobhan
styles: warm female lead vocalist, clear diction, every word easy to understand
gentle choir backing on the chorus
sections:
[Verse 1]
Lord, I'm coming to You on my knees tonight
For the one who held my hand and raised me right
Siobhan, my mother, she's been tired and weak
So I bring her to You, the Healer that we seek

[Chorus]
Lay Your hand on Siobhan
Lift her up and make her strong
You said You would restore her health
Lord, I'm holding to Your word alone
Siobhan, You know her name
Heal her body, ease her pain

[Verse 2]
She sang over my cradle when the nights were long
Now I'm singing over her, Lord, keep her carrying on
Every morning that she wakes, let her feel You near
Every breath she takes, Lord, let her know You're here

[Chorus]
Lay Your hand on Siobhan
Lift her up and make her strong
You said You would restore her health
Lord, I'm holding to Your word alone
Siobhan, You know her name
Heal her body, ease her pain

[Bridge]
For I will restore health unto thee
And I will heal thee of thy wounds
That's Your promise, Lord, I believe
Siobhan is safe in Your hands

[Final Chorus]
Lay Your hand on Siobhan
Lift her up and make her strong
Siobhan, You know her name
Heal her body, ease her pain

name: Nevaeh
styles: soft tender female vocal, grandmotherly warmth, clear diction
sections:
[Verse 1]
Close your eyes, my sweet Nevaeh
Grandma's here to pray
The stars are out, the night is soft
The Lord will light your way

[Chorus]
Angels watching over you, Nevaeh
Keeping you in all your ways
On the road and in the schoolyard
Through your nights and through your days
Nevaeh, little one
You are covered by the Son

[Verse 2]
When you're grown and far from home
And I am not around
Remember Grandma's lullaby
And the love that you have found

[Chorus]
Angels watching over you, Nevaeh
Keeping you in all your ways
On the road and in the schoolyard
Through your nights and through your days
Nevaeh, little one
You are covered by the Son

[Bridge]
For He shall give His angels charge over thee
To keep thee in all thy ways
Every step, Nevaeh, every dream
He will hold you all your days

name: Joaquin
styles: warm male baritone lead vocal, clear diction, every word easy to understand
sections:
[Verse 1]
There's an empty chair at the table, Lord
And his coat still on the hook
Joaquin, our daddy, went home to You
With his worn old Bible book

[Chorus]
Hold Joaquin in Your arms tonight
Tell him we're doing fine
He walked with You on this dusty road
Now he's walking in the light
Joaquin, we'll see you again
Where there's no more goodbye

[Verse 2]
He worked those hands from dawn to dark
He never once complained
He taught us how to bow our heads
And thank You through the rain

[Chorus]
Hold Joaquin in Your arms tonight
Tell him we're doing fine
He walked with You on this dusty road
Now he's walking in the light
Joaquin, we'll see you again
Where there's no more goodbye

[Bridge]
And God shall wipe away all tears
And there shall be no more death
Joaquin, you're in His house now
And we're holding to that rest
